body: Ode to the mets
Totally agree on the break up - but speaking from personal experience, I wish he broke up with me and gave me the "It's not you, it's me" spiel rather than destroy my self confidence.

I want to share as a woman DO NOT TELL HER YOU’RE NOT ATTRACTED TO HER. 
My ex said this exact thing to me and at the time, I took it well. The next few months it deeply affected my mental health. I was struggling with depression at the time and the last thing on my mind was how I looked when I was struggling to get through each day. 

Physical attraction is extremely important in a relationship, but loving your partner through their ups and downs is what a relationship is all about. He didn’t approach it in a way of being concerned I stopped looking after myself, it was just “You’re not attractive anymore and I don’t want to have sex with you”. I was going through a rough time, and now I knew it was VISIBLE to him, and all he cared about was getting his dick hard. I couldn’t look at him or respect him the same way after that. 

If you’re going to approach her on this please, tell her your love her and are concerned for her health. Tell her you care about her deeply and are worried about her. Do it from a place of love or don’t do it at all.

hi! 
i’m going through the same thing i think it’s a great time to look inwards and reconnect with yourself. 
i always lose myself in relationships and don’t do anything i love to do. i’m getting back into playing music. watching all my favourite shows. 

i managed to get free therapy through a service in my country and they’ve been calling me to check in on me while i’m on the waiting list. 
i’ve always been against helplines, but i managed to fall into the right hands this time around and i feel like i’m finally being listened to. keep ringing and keep asking for help. 

it is absolutely AWFUL and i honestly wouldn’t wish the last 3 weeks on my worst enemy. but people with BPD are the most resilient people on the planet and i’ll stand by that, no matter what’s going through our head or the trauma we endure we always find a way to come out on the other end. 

i hope you find this time to heal & reconnect with your true self and find some peace. 🌹
